description: This file contains custom assertion methods for testing instances of ThingModifiedEvent in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract assertion class and provides methods to verify properties like type, thing ID, headers, revision, entity, and resource path.

classes.name: ThingModifiedEventAssert
classes.description: Custom assertion class for verifying properties of ThingModifiedEvent objects in tests.

methods.name: ThingModifiedEventAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion object with the actual event.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Asserts that the event has the expected type.

methods.name: hasThingId
methods.description: Asserts that the event has the expected Thing ID.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the event has the expected DittoHeaders.

methods.name: withRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the event has the expected revision number.

methods.name: withEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the event contains the specified entity (JSON value).

methods.name: withoutEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the event has no entity.

methods.name: withResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts the resource path of the event matches expected value, with variations for path segments.
